mappings.meaning: Entry for reading the second packed source byte after the first sample post-advance bound gate in each unrolled art-scaling tail iteration.
Merge the two sampled or zeroed bytes with the caller-supplied masks and store one packed output byte in each unrolled art-scaling tail iteration.
